name: plan-crutches
description: Visual review of Claude's plan before it runs: a browser page with the change tree, OK marks per file, signatures and +/- diffs of the changed methods, comments, an Explain tab, plan versions with compare and restore, a 3D diagram and Q&A.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language of the review pane (en or uk)

model.title: Model
model.description: Model alias for the light calls: plan extraction when the plan has no plan-crutches block, picking the project files an implementation needs, and answers when the session cannot be forked

bodyModel.title: Implementation model
bodyModel.description: Model alias that writes method bodies from the whole plan, the generated code and the project files. Empty means the Model option.

plansDir.title: Review files folder
plansDir.description: Where the Markdown records and SVG files go. Empty, an absolute path or a path under ~ means a shared folder with one subfolder per project. Any other path is a folder inside the project. The live review and the saved plan versions always sit under ~/.claude/plan-crutches/<project>.

summaryLimit.title: Summary limit
summaryLimit.description: Characters of the plan summary shown before the Show all button

port.title: Page port
port.description: Port of the review page server on 127.0.0.1. 0 picks a free port each time; a taken port falls back to a free one.

openIn.title: Open the page in
openIn.description: auto: the Claude desktop browser pane when available, else the system browser. system: the system browser. none: only show the link.

nodePath.title: Node binary
nodePath.description: Path of the node executable that runs the page server. Empty means node from PATH, then the usual install locations.
